Author: Sabina

 In The High Court Of Judicature For

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature For
 Rajasthan Bench At Jaipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Accused is in Central Jail, Kota.
Versus State of Rajasthan through P.P.
For Petitioner(s) : Shri Arvind Bhardwaj

For Respondent : Shri A.D. Khan, P.P HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE SABINA Order 3/10/2017 Petitioner had faced trial under Section 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954 (hereinafter referred to as the "Act").
Trial court vide judgment/order dated 6.1.1998 ordered the conviction and sentence of the petitioner under Section 7/16 of the Act.
Appeal filed by the petitioner was dismissed by the Appellate Court vide order dated 30.6.2001.
Hence, the present petition.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the independent witness had not supported the prosecution case.
Be that as it may, learned counsel has submitted that he does not challenge the conviction of the petitioner under Section 7/16 of the Act.

Learned Counsel has submitted that the sentence qua imprisonment of the petitioner be reduced to the period already undergone by him as the petitioner is facing the criminal proceedings since the year 1989.
Petitioner is now suffering from various old age ailments.

Learned counsel has placed reliance on the decision of Punjab &
Haryana High Court in Puran Mal Vs. State of Haryana 2009(4) R.C.R. (Criminal) 527.

entities.text: Puran Mal Vs. State of Haryana 2009(4) R.C.R. (Criminal) 527
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned State Counsel, on the other hand, has opposed the petition.

Keeping in view the facts and circumstances of the case it would be just and expedient to reduce the sentence qua imprisonment of the petitioner to the period already undergone by him and enhance the quantum of fine.
Accordingly, conviction of the petitioner under Section 7/16 of the Act is maintained.

However,
sentence qua imprisonment of the petitioner is reduced to the period already undergone by him subject to his depositing fine to the tune of Rs. 10,000/-.
Fine be deposited by the petitioner before the trial court within two months from today failing which this appeal shall be deemed to have been dismissed.
